name: scenario_0744
description: The user is working on an infographics project and needs to reply to a client's email with specific statistics extracted from six different infographic images. The user uses a note to keep track of the project's email thread ID.

gmail.emails.subject: Infographics Project Data Requests
gmail.emails.body:
Hi Joyce,

Could you please review the infographics and extract the following 6 data points for me?
1. UK 2013 Clothes & Sports Goods percentage
2. managers' social recruiting percentage
3. top Australian VOD service
4. percentage of small businesses on Facebook
5. percentage of Original Graphics used by marketers
6. number of regulatory authorized diagnostic tests for Covid-19

Thanks,
Client

simple_note.notes.title: Project Requests
simple_note.notes.content: Infographics project - Email thread ID: thread_789

Once the assistant confirms the reply has been sent, you can end the conversation.

  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0

  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2

entity_data.subject: Re: Infographics Project Data Requests
entity_data.body:
Hi,

Here are the statistics you requested, extracted from the infographics:
1. 51% (UK 2013 Clothes & Sports Goods)
2. 42% (managers' social recruiting)
3. YouTube (top Australian VOD service)
4. 90% (small businesses on Facebook)
5. 37% (Original Graphics)
6. 41 (regulatory authorized diagnostic tests)

Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Joyce
